q: agostino de franceschi b. 2[2 or 8] july 18[??], d. 1[1 or 5] september 18[??] · pieve di santa maria di gorto the oldest de franceschi stone in the ground, and the archive has now failed twice to read it. the inscription was cut, then effaced when the stone was reused, and francesco de franceschi 1887-1945 and liduina cecconi 1897-1977 were applied over it in metal letters. what is certain: «qui giace / agostino de franceschi / nato 2? luglio 18?? / morto 1? settembre 18?? / moglie e [figli] / posero». a man buried by his wife and children, and the months july and september. two readings of the same photographs have given 26 july 1822 and 22 july 1853 for the birth, 11 september and 15 september for the death. enlarged, the birth day is a 2 followed by a 2 or an 8; the death day a 1 followed by a 1 or a 5; and the years are inside a blown highlight that no amount of processing recovers - pushed hard, the stone's own crystal texture starts producing digits that are not there. this entry now says what the stone says and no more. it wants one photograph in raking light, and the ovaro civil death register would settle it outright.

(doc.) historiographer of istria, strenuous asserter of the italian character of his land , 1809 1893 cut in roman numerals, in italian, in a village whose croatian neighbours were at that moment arguing the opposite case in print. the quarrel is on the gologorica page, and this inscription is one side of it, in stone. the tomb is a walled monument a cross above, the arms in the pediment , his tablet in the centre between fluted pilasters in pink marble, and a family tablet to either side. three of his children and his wife are on those side tablets, and all four died before he did. --- 29 september 2026 the official roll, and the seat he was elected for. defranceschi karl k.k. rathsprotokollist pisino küstenland the list of the 422 deputies of the first austrian reichstag, 1848 49 , with name, character, electoral district and land. virginija de franceschi marfan (1895 1981) gračišće 1895 1981 sixth of the eleven children of antonio defranceschi and maria valhart, and the only one of them still in the ground at gračišće. the stone, photographed by david and read here at full resolution: f. de franceschi marfan virginija ✱ 30. iii. 1895 ✝ 28. xii. 1981 (doc.) the american reunion chart of 2012 gives virginia (3/30/1895) the same day, month and year, written down in california a hundred and seventeen years after it happened. the stone gives what the chart could not: she died 28 december 1981 , aged eighty-six. ⚠ 29 september 2026 that death date had been published on the eleven since the plot was first photographed, and it had never reached this record , which carried d = null . a second photograph is what exposed it. the rule is the archive's own: a finding is not done until it is in every file that asserts it. she married giovanni marfan ivan in croatian, and the stone beside hers gives his dates and she is the reason the two families are buried together. she was the niece of josip defranceschi, who took this archive's own line down to crikvenica in 1890, and therefore the first cousin of anton rudolf. one half of the family went to the kvarner, germany, south africa and australia; the other to new york, buenos aires and tuscany. she stayed, and was still receiving her american cousins in the family house in the 1970s. carnia out of carnia our own line, from mione and agrons to gologorica, gračišće, crikvenica, senj and the diaspora the eleven

(doc.) her father is mattio bergamo , of this parish. ⚠ and a d.no mattio bergamo had stood witness at antonia defranceschi's wedding on 7 january 1779 , four years before this one so the two houses were already acquainted. joannes mathias franceschi gologorica 1798 he was parish priest of gračišće, and this archive had him down as the word don . idem [domus] 63 29 martij [1798] admodum r[everen]d[u]s d[omi]n[u]s math. de franceschi, ex parocho gallegna[nensi] annorum 62 paralisia (doc dapa zm34k-214 , m01069235, page 15 of the gologorica death register.) ex parocho gallignanensi formerly parish priest of gallignana, which is gračišće : not a neighbouring parish picked at random but this line's own second home , the parish francisca and joanna came out of. he died at gologorica on 29 march 1798, aged sixty-two, of a stroke, at house 63. born about 1736. what this row held before: his name, the place gologorica , the line carnia , and for a note the single word don . a title somebody had written down and nobody had looked for. ⚠ his parents are not established. the entry gives his age and his office and no father. the book's index files him under defranceschi joseph n.º 17 the household this archive follows but an index is a clerk's filing decision, not a statement of descent , and no parent is attached to him on the strength of it. what to do next: ask the gračišće registers who held the cure in the 1760s 1790s. they are on the reel that is already the first errand. ⭐ 6 october 2026, same walk and he was parish priest of gologorica too. the sepeliens column of the death register who performed the burial reads at the head of 1787 : [defran] ceschi, p[aro]chus loci defranceschi, parish priest of this place, with idem running down the page beneath him. (doc dapa zm34k-214 , m01069230, page 5.) so a priest of this surname was burying the people of his own village in 1787 88 , and the 1798 entry styles him by gallignana rather than gologorica which is what you would expect of a man who had given up the local cure years before, and is why the book's index calls him ex parochus . ⚠ one man or two is not settled. the index lists only one defranceschi priest, which favours one man with two cures; it does not prove it. the gračišće registers would, and they are on the reel that is the first errand. --- ⭐⭐ 9 october 2026 he names himself, and he is four years earlier in this cure than this row had him. the gologorica marriage register 1770 1789, opened for the first time today, has him officiating in the first person which in a marriage entry means the hand is his own . | | | |---|---| | 12 november 1782 | per me parochum franceschi in facie ecclesiæ | | 12 january 1785 | per me parocum joannē mathiam franceschi in facie ecclesiæ | | 22 november 1785 | ego idem parochus de franceschi hujus loci | (doc dapa zm34k-214 , m01069003 and m01069004.) ⭐ the forename this row already carried now has a document behind it. this row was headed joannes mathias franceschi while the only evidence in the archive was a burial reading math. de franceschi and a death column with no forename at all. the 1785 entry is the first time he is seen writing it himself. ⚠ and it is still only half proved: mathiam is written out, joannē is an abbreviation, and a second construction has not been found. ⭐ he held gologorica by november 1782. this row's earliest sighting of him in this cure was the sepeliens column heading 1786 . the marriage register puts him in it four years earlier, with the fuller title parochus rather than presbyter loci . ⚠ one man or two is narrowed, not settled. he is parish priest of gologorica continuously from 12 november 1782 to at least 22 november 1785. so if the gračišće cure was also his, it falls before 1782 or after 1785 and his burial calls him ex parocho gallegnanensi , past tense. still the gračišće registers that would decide it, and still on the reel that is the first errand. and he writes the surname both ways in one book franceschi twice, de franceschi once. worth knowing before anybody treats the two forms as two families. gologorica carnia out of carnia our own line, from mione and agrons to gologorica, gračišće, crikvenica, senj and the diaspora read off the register

t: Jacobo de Franceschi (of Svetvinčenat, fl. 1737–1752) — at least two men
q: jacobo de franceschi (of svetvinčenat, fl. 1737 1752) at least two men svetvinčenat the best-attested man of the name at the castle in these years, and he is nearly always somebody else's godfather. 26 december 1737 he baptises twins. …baptizavit duos infantulos geminos natos hodie mane a jacobo de franceschi, et anzola ejus legitima uxore ambobus ex hac parochia , quibus fuit positum nomen, uni [cesare?] alteri antonij two boys born that morning, godparents natale zanzevich (?) and clara, widow of bartolomeo braccato . in no index anywhere. and he stands at other people's fonts through the whole stretch 27 november 1737, 12 january 1738, 16 february 1738 which is what a settled householder does. by 1752 his wife has a different name. twice that year the register writes the godmother as his wife: franca marcario uxor jacobi defranceschi on 26 march and francisca uxor jacobi defranceschi on 17 december. and within ten months the register gives him three different wives. anzola at the twins' baptism, 26 december 1737 ; agata uxor jacobi de franceschi on 10 august 1738 ; jacoba uxor jacobi de franceschi on 7 september 1738 ; and then angela uxor jacobi defranceschi on 1 march 1739 angela is anzola , so she is alive on both sides of the other two. one man cannot have had three wives in those ten months , which leaves two possibilities and this archive prefers neither: either more than one jacobo de franceschi was living in the parish at once , or the godparent formula is not reliable about husbands' forenames and there is a reason to suspect the second, because jacoba is named six weeks earlier as the wife of pietro , and a clerk writing jacoba uxor jacobi may simply have been pulled by her own name. (see the method note.) by 1752 the wife is francisca marcario. whether that is a remarriage or a second man is the same unanswered question, fifteen years later. (doc for every appearance; the identity across 1737 and 1752 is inf and flagged.) film 005497885, images 115 117 births 1709 1764 of svetvinčenat, read on the plate 22 september 2026. --- 23 september 2026 a second baptism, and then a withdrawal. the baptism is real. casparus filius legitimus jacobi defranceschi, et ~~francisca~~ ejus legitimæ uxoris, amborum ex hac parochia ⚠ the mother's name in this quotation is wrong; she is pascasia , re-read 28 september 2026, see below and /corrections/ born 1 june 1743 casparus di jacobo defranceschi 1743. nicolina teserati (1773 1778) besides domenico gasparo, son of giacomo baptised in 1732 . forty-six years of one forename fathering children. that is two generations at least, and the archive cannot she was never caspar's wife. caspar's wife is maria , named as his six times between 1744 and 1749. this is a stronger demonstration of the godparent-formula failure than the 1738 case the method note baptisms and a joint line, so the two wrong entries can be convicted rather than merely suspected. the clerk wrote the wrong husband twice, for one woman, fourteen months apart. and francisca is still t: Joannes Baptista de Franceschi (of Svetvinčenat, d. by 1737)

(inf for the identification; doc for the baptism.) and she raises a question the archive cannot answer. fourteen months before her, on 27 july 1738 , petro de franceschi et jacoba ejus legitima uxore baptise a daughter anna euphemia . same mother's name, same daughter's name, two different fathers' forenames. and the balance has since shifted against batta . on 29 december 1739 , eleven weeks after this baptism, the same register enters a godmother as jacoba uxor petri defranceschi and jacoba was already pietro's wife in july 1738. so the register names jacoba as pietro's wife twice, on either side of the one entry that gives her to a batta. the likeliest reading is now that this child belongs to pietro and jacoba and that the clerk wrote the wrong husband here which would make her the second euphemia of that household, the first having died. the entry still reads batta under magnification and has not been altered ; what has changed is which way the evidence leans. joannes baptista de franceschi ex cargna (1742) svetvinčenat die 20 xbris 1742 … baptizavi unam infantulam spuriam , natam heri, a gregorio bercar et maria simebich ex parochia barbana , cui positum fuit nomen victoria . patrini fuerunt joannes baptista de franceschi, ex cargn. , et maria uxor gasparis perlar . he is the only person of this name in the whole register who is given an origin. everyone else is ambo ex hac parochia or nothing at all the clerk marks him because he is not of the parish. cargna is the venetian and italian form of carnia . the word is abbreviated with a suspension stroke and is given here as read. (the expansion is inf ; the letters c-a-r-g-n are doc .) why this matters more than another godparent line. ex carnia is the exact phrase the fiume marriage register attaches to valentino de franceschi on 28 february 1737 and joannes baptista is the forename at the centre of the fiume question, where a man of that name and unknown origin fathers a child at fiume in 1748 . this is not that man, and is not claimed to be. it is the first document this archive has found that puts the right surname, the right forename and a carnian origin together inside istria in the right decade . (lore for any connection to fiume; doc for the entry.) and it unsettles the two joannes baptistas already here. one was dead by october 1737; one stood godfather in april 1739. whether the 1739 man and this one are the same and therefore whether the svetvinčenat battistas are themselves carnian incomers the register does not say. film 005497885, image 132 births 1709 1764 of svetvinčenat, read on the plate 23 september 2026 and magnified three times. in no index anywhere. a third time, and the fullest spelling yet: ex cargno . 14 september 1744 , at the baptism of michael son of mari milovar: patrini ad sacrum fontem fuerunt joannes baptis-/:ta defranceschi ex cargno , et catharina uxor bene mesciarovich the surname broken across the line, the origin whole. magnified. film 005497885, image 138 , read 23 september 2026. pascasia de franceschi, later calluzzi (fl. 1743 1765) svetvinčenat she is the best-attested woman of this household and until today she had no page of her own. wife of a jacobo de franceschi , and named as such in four separate acts of the baptism register and one of the marriage register which is more than most men of this parish can show. her children, all baptised at svetvinčenat casparus 1 june 1743 , martina antonia 28 march 1746 , antonia 20 october 1747 , and victoria 25 march 1750 . four children in seven years. (doc for each.) 29 april 1753 the register names the couple in one phrase patrini fuerunt, jacobus defranceschi, et pascasia ejus uxor husband and wife together, with no room for a clerk to attach her to the wrong man. that joint line is the firmest thing this archive holds about her. ⚠ twice the register gets her husband wrong. pascasia uxor caspari defranceschi on 16 december 1751 and again on 3 february 1752 . she was never caspar's wife caspar's wife is maria, named as his six times between 1744 and 1749. the clerk wrote the wrong husband for one woman, fourteen months apart, and this archive can convict him because the right answer is known independently. 22 october 1765 she is a widow, and she marries again. domenico calluzzi q.m pietro hà contrato il matrimonio per verba de presenti con pasqua ved.a q.m giacomo de fran-/ceschi in 2di uoti film 005497886, frame 53 , the marriage register, read at 2.5×. pasqua is pascasia , and this is the first time the archive has been able to date the death of any jacobo of this castle: her husband is dead by 22 october 1765 . (doc.) ⚠ her name was misread here for five days. until 28 september 2026 her first appearance the 1743 baptism of casparus was published with the mother's name as francisca . it is pascasia, proved against the same clerk's franciscus on the facing leaf and his own pascasia nine images on. see /corrections/. it moved her household's start from 1746 back to 1743. born about 1720 on the arithmetic of her children and her remarriage estimated, never printed as a fact . svetvinčenat unplaced a documented istrian or kvarner household this archive will not attach to any line rijeka, bakar, svetvinčenat, kaštelir, poreč, labin and the rest read off the register

t: Francisca de Franceschi, wife of Matteo (fl. 1741–1752)
q: francisca de franceschi, wife of matteo (fl. 1741 1752) svetvinčenat wife of matteo defranceschi of svetvinčenat, and the mother of the first defranceschi bride this archive has found. her children and this page said two until 28 september 2026, when the archive's own households file turned out to know four helena, nata die 5 currentis a matthæo defranceschi, et francisca ejus legitima uxore ambobus ex hac parochia , born 5 august 1742 ; and irena, born 11 february 1752 , matthæi defranceschi, et franciscæ ejus legitimæ uxoris . (doc for both.) she is already named as matteo's wife in august 1741 , so the household stands at the castle across at least eleven years . ⚠ her name is the one this archive misread. on 28 september 2026 the mother of casparus 1743 was corrected from francisca to pascasia and the test that settled it was her own name in irena's entry , where the clerk's tall crossed f and narrow minims share not one letterform with pascasia at 7×. she is the control that proved she was not there. see /corrections/. her daughter helena married 9 february 1766 , by which time matteo was dead . the act does not name her, alive or dead this parish does not mention a bride's mother. born about 1718 estimated . 28 september 2026 a third daughter. fusca marries on 17 november 1773 as filia q. mathiæ de franceschi . helena, irena and fusca and as at helena's wedding, the mother is not named, alive or dead. this parish does not mention her. ⚠ a correction this page owed itself. it was written saying she had two known children. (doc.) 30 march 1773 she remarries: joannes volge, et maria relicta q.m gasparis de franceschi the widow of the late gasparo . (doc.) ⚠ her existence is what convicts the register twice. pascasia uxor caspari defranceschi appears on 16 december 1751 and 3 february 1752 but caspar's wife is this woman, named as his through the 1740s, and pascasia is jacobo's, proved by a joint line in 1753. because maria is on the page, the clerk's two errors can be convicted rather than merely suspected. and she brackets her husband's death. he is alive as a witness on 13 august 1766 gaspare de franceschi q.m ant.o ex hoc castro and she is his widow by 30 march 1773 . so he died between those two dates. t: Antonio de Franceschi of Svetvinčenat (d. by 1766)
q: antonio de franceschi of svetvinčenat (d. by 1766) svetvinčenat named only once, and only as a dead man but the naming settled an identification this archive could not otherwise make. 13 august 1766 , among the witnesses to the marriage of mattheus razzan and catharina percovich: ac gaspare de franceschi q.m ant.o ex hoc castro gasparo de franceschi, son of the late antonio, of this castle. film 005497886, frame 55 , read at 2.5×. (doc for the patronymic.) so there was an antonio de franceschi of this castle who fathered a gasparo and was dead by august 1766. what it did. three gasparos were in play when the 1762 witness was filed unassigned . two fell on this one word : the twin of 1737 and casparus of 1743 are both sons of jacobo , named as such in their own baptisms. the surviving candidate is gasparo × maria. a patronymic did in a line what an argument about m.ro versus d.no could never have done. ⚠ he may already be on this site under another row. the parish holds several antonios an antonio de franceschi born 1704 among them and this page does not claim to be a new man , only a man the record names. if a documented link is ever found, this row should be merged rather than kept. (the person is doc; the separation from every other antonio is unproven.) born about 1690 on the arithmetic of a son active from the 1740s estimated, and wide . ⚠ he is not antonio de franceschi, witness 1773, and the dates say so. that man witnesses six marriages at this castle between january and october 1773 and has a grown son, vittorio. this one was already q.m dead on 13 august 1766. two men of the name, seven years apart, and the register is explicit about which is which. whether they are grandfather and grandson, or uncle and nephew, or unrelated, nothing here says. svetvinčenat unplaced a documented istrian or kvarner household this archive will not attach to any line rijeka, bakar, svetvinčenat, kaštelir, poreč, labin and the rest read off the register

mattio santalezza (fl. 1766) svetvinčenat (from the albona territory) the man who married the first defranceschi bride this archive has found. 9 february 1766, svetvinčenat: mattio figlio di q.m michiel santalezza nativo dal territorio d' albona ma per il suo domicilio d'anni 12 c.a in questo distretto di s. vicenti … hà contrato il matrimonio per verba de presenti con elena figlia di q.m mattio de franceschi nativa di questo castello film 005497886, frame 53 . (doc.) he is an incomer. born in the territory of albona (labin), resident in the district of svetvinčenat about twelve years , and admitted on a letter of credit the parish had to accept before he could marry here the register says so explicitly. his father michiel was already dead. the banns were cut from three to two by the vicar capitular of parenzo, and the two were read on the same day . a second santalezza marries into the parish the same year josephus santalezza q.m gregorij de territorio albone , 28 november 1766 , to agatha obrovaz. whether they are brothers the register does not say. born about 1740 estimated . --- 28 september 2026 mathias santalezza stands witness at his sister-in-law's wedding. 17 november 1773: fusca de franceschi , another daughter of the late mattia de franceschi, marries marc'antonio jacomini of parenzo , and the witnesses are d. antonius de franceschi, ac mathias santalezza . film 005497886, frame 66. (doc for the appearance.) that the witness is this man is inference, not statement the act gives him no patronymic and no parish. but mathias is mattio , the parish is the one he married into seven years earlier, and the bride is his wife's sister. t: The Defranceschi who won the Istrian rural communes, 1879
q: the defranceschi who won the istrian rural communes, 1879 istria in the summer of 1879 a defranceschi beat the croatian national candidate in the rural communes of istria, and two newspapers are still angry about it. galeb (bakar), 15 july 1879: u našoj posestrimi istri izabran je dr. d. vitezić, dočim je drugi narodni kandidat dr. klodić u seoskih obćina podlegao talijanu defranceskiju . in our sister istria dr. d. vitezić was elected, while the other national candidate dr. klodić was defeated in the rural communes by the italian defranceski. (doc.) naša sloga , 16 august 1879 returns to it at length and without charity, naming the men of the poreč district who went over dušom i tijelom za defranceskia body and soul for defranceschi and calling them odpadnici , renegades. (doc.) this is the name in politics, on the italian side, against the croatian national movement and it is the first time this archive has held a defranceschi as a candidate rather than as a subject of administration. ⚠ which defranceschi is not established. the obvious candidate is carlo de franceschi (1809 1893), the istrian historian and politician, who was seventy in 1879 and whose own page already carries 1879 as the year of his l'istria , and nothing about an election . that is not evidence, only proximity. the province held other men of the name, and this page will not put a face to the surname until a source names one. fusca de franceschi (m. 1773) svetvinčenat a daughter of matteo defranceschi that this archive did not know it had and her sister's husband stood witness at her wedding. 17 november 1773, svetvinčenat: marc'antonius jacomini filius andreæ, parenzensis , et fusca filia q. mathiæ de franceschi , parochiana hujus ecclesiæ, dispensatis a denunciationibus, per verba de presenti mat[rimonio] juncti per me d. michaele luciani ex commissione parochi, addita b[enedictio]ne. testes d. antonius de franceschi, ac mathias santalezza. film 005497886, frame 66 , read at 2×. (doc for the act.) her father is dead q. mathiæ and the banns were dispensed entirely. ⚠ why she is almost certainly matteo's daughter, and why almost . the act names no mother and no age. but the second witness is mathias santalezza and on 9 february 1766 elena, daughter of the late mattio de franceschi, married mattio santalezza of the albona territory. a santalezza standing at the wedding of another filia q. mathiæ de franceschi is the bride's brother-in-law , which is exactly who a family puts there. (inf, and strong: the same surname, the same parish, the same dead father, and a witness who is already married into the household.) so matteo and francisca had at least three daughters helena (1742), irena (1752) and fusca and fusca's baptism has not been found. she must be born before about 1758 to marry in 1773, which puts her inside the 1709 1764 volume this archive has read in parts. she is not in it yet , and that is worth saying plainly rather than quietly estimating a year. her husband is an outsider of a familiar kind. marc'antonio jacomini, son of andrea, of parenzo poreč like elena's santalezza from albona and nicolò corva dà cargna two months later. the castle's daughters married in from the whole province. born about 1755 estimated from the marriage alone , and the page carries no birth year as fact. svetvinčenat unplaced a documented istrian or kvarner household this archive will not attach to any line rijeka, bakar, svetvinčenat, kaštelir, poreč, labin and the rest read off the register

anna kalanj (de franceschi) (1864 1936?) klenovica, vinodol 1864 this archive's own great-great-grandmother, and until today she had no page. baptised entry 2 of 1864 at ledenice , the vinodol parish above crikvenica: anna, legitimate, daughter of josephus kalanj and rosalia née perković , at klenovica house 22 ; godparents josephus ban and his wife anna; baptised by vincentius segulja, parish priest. born 3 january 1864. brinjensis parochiæ ruricolæ country people of the parish of brinje. (doc dapa zm34k-214 , m01068999, gologorica marriages 1770 1789.) ⭐ detti leonardi was a patronymic all along. the gologorica death book's index files a girl who died at house 31 in 1786 under defranceschi joanes bapta detti leonardi n.º 12 , and this archive read that as a byname for telling two households apart. the marriage register writes it in latin: q.ᵐ leonardi filius son of the late leonardus. ⭐ he is a weaver , professionis suæ textor the only man on that page of the register who is not agricola . why that matters to the carnian argument, and how the word was verified against the same scribe's other hand. ⚠ not the same man as joannes baptista defranceschi, son of josephus , born 1752, of house 36 and later 17, widower of catharina née jablich. the same volume distinguishes them nine months apart : that man appears as a witness on 15 september 1773 as joanne baptista defranceschi filio d.ni josephi . ⚠ no dates, no age, no parents attached as fact. a leonardus defranceschi of gologorica died in 1773, the year before this marriage, which fits q.ᵐ exactly but the entry does not date the father's death and more than one leonardus lived here, so the identification is inf and the link is not made. gologorica carnia out of carnia our own line, from mione and agrons to gologorica, gračišće, crikvenica, senj and the diaspora read off the register

6 september 1626 folio 108 die sexta septembris p.br joannes sardich baptizavit joannis anthonij de franceschi filium nomine joannem anth.m , natum ex eius matre legitima nomine lucia . compatres autem fuerunt d. anthonius jacobus cursius et d. margarita v.q.d. anthonij jachomin . the father is giovanni antonio de franceschi ; the mother is lucia ; the son takes the father's name entire. this is the household. everything else on this page is the same two parents.

t: 19 April 1628 folio 119 and the godfather is the Captain of Fiume
q: 19 april 1628 folio 119 and the godfather is the captain of fiume die 19 aprilis presbiter joannes sardich baptizavit joannis anthonij de franceschi filiam nomine joanna victoriam , natam ex eius matre legitima nomine lucia . compatres autem fuerunt ill.mus d.nus stefanus, liber baro a rouuere, invictissimi ferdinandi secundi romanorum imperatoris consiliarius, et camerarius ac pincerna, ac civitatis fluminis capitaneus , et d. cassandra uxor d. petri mariae monaldi . the imperial captain of the city stood godfather to this child. that is the highest office in fiume, held by a baron of the emperor's own household, and he is standing at the font for a de franceschi baby. whatever this family was in fiume in 1628, it was not obscure.

t: 9 September 1632 folio 143 and this one was baptised by a bishop
q: 9 september 1632 folio 143 and this one was baptised by a bishop die 9 7bris ill.mus et r.mus d.nus joannes baptista agatich, episcopus segniensis et administrator modrusiensis, s.s.c.m. consiliarius , baptizavit joannis anthonij de franceschi filiam nomine mariam , natam ex eius matre legitima nomine lucia , quae supradicta maria fuit prius catechizata a me, plebano fluminis. compatres autem fuerunt d.nus joannes josephus p[…], v. con. fluminis , et d.na cassandra uxor d. petri mariae monaldi . the bishop of senj came and did it himself. ivan krstitelj agatić giovanni battista agatić was bishop of senj and modruš and an imperial councillor; he is a figure in croatian church history, not a passing curate. and cassandra monaldi is godmother for the second time in four years, which is what a family friend looks like in a register.

t: Omiš, 12 January 1644 and the index has the sex wrong
s: And then the Omiš and Split records were read too all four
q: omiš, 12 january 1644 and the index has the sex wrong l'anno del sig.re 1644 adi 12 genaro … il sig.r don mateo berkoveo d'almissa , sac[erdote] cur[a]to, ha battezato il figlio nato li 9 instante di cap.n zuane de franceschi et sig.ra elena coniugati , al quale fu posto nome nicolò , di questa parochia. compari furono sig.r gierolimo marinovich et sig.ra francesca de franceschi . familysearch indexes this child as nicolaa de franceschi, female . the register says il figlio and al quale fu posto nome nicolò . it is a boy. that is now corrected here. and two things the index does not carry at all. the father is styled cap.n captain . and the godmother is francesca de franceschi , a woman of the family, standing for her own kin: indexes transcribe parents and children, never godparents, so she exists in no index anywhere.

t: …and she is on the same page twice
s: And then the Omiš and Split records were read too all four
q: …and she is on the same page twice …et m[adonn]a zuana giugali, al qual fu posto nome marco di questa parochia. compari furono … cap.n nicolò c[…] et sig.ra francesca de franceschi . the entry directly above, in march 1644, for another family's son. the same woman, the same page, a second godparent turn. a de franceschi standing at the font twice in one opening of the omiš book is exactly the pattern this archive found at svetvinčenat the family that is always being asked. neither appearance is in any index.

t: Omiš, 29 March 1645 born about 1581, the oldest of all
s: And then the Omiš and Split records were read too all four
q: omiš, 29 march 1645 born about 1581, the oldest of all gioannes maria de franceschi obijt die 29 martij, anno etatis suae 64 . one line in a column of deaths, with the year 1645 ruled off at the right. sixty-four in 1645 means born about 1581 the earliest birth year for this surname anywhere in the croatian record, and a full generation before the fiume household above. he is an exact contemporary of pietro antonio detto perini de franceschi (1588 1661) , the man at the head of the omiš family's own twenty-generation chart. this archive is not going to make him perini's brother on a shared surname and a shared decade. it will say that the chart's first generation, which has always rested on the family's own paper, now has a man of the name dying in the parish register beside it. one correction to the index: familysearch dates this death 20 march. the register reads 29 the same hand writes 28 four times in the lines below, and the glyph here carries the descender of a 9.

t: Split, 17 October 1700 a child not expected to live
s: And then the Omiš and Split records were read too all four
q: split, 17 october 1700 a child not expected to live adì 17 ottobre 1700 antonio figlio di egidio de franceschi et di sua consorte maria , al quale fu data l'acqua in casa, in caso di necessità , da me … sac[erdote]; et hoggi supplite le cerimonie … in chiesa di s. gio: battista , con licenza dell'ill.mo … compari furono sig.r … zuane guido, con assistenza del … l'acqua in casa, in caso di necessità is the phrase for an emergency baptism: the child was thought to be dying and was christened where he lay. he lived, and the ceremonies were supplied in church afterwards which is why there is a record at all, and why it is dated to the day of the supplying, not the day of the birth. split had never appeared on this site as a place of the name. it does now, with a household: egidio de franceschi and maria , in the cathedral parish, in 1700. the last lines of the entry the officiant and the second godparent are still not read.

t: Split, 18 May 1716 and he is a canon of Candia
s: And then the Omiš and Split records were read too all four
q: split, 18 may 1716 and he is a canon of candia adì 18 maggio 1716 [il m.to r.do sig.r] can.co don nicolò de franceschi ⟨ can.co di s. vito di candia ⟩ passò da questa alla miglior vita d'anni 90 incirca , munito de ss. sacram.ti dal r.do padre capucino , capelano del ospitale, et fù sepolto nella chiesa del domo in coro nella sepoltura delli sig.ri can.ci . the index called him nicolo de franceschi, burial 18 may 1716, birth 1626 . the register makes him somebody entirely different. he was a canon , and he was buried where canons are buried: in the choir of the cathedral of split , in the chapter's own vault. the cathedral of split is diocletian's mausoleum. he lies inside a roman emperor's tomb. and then the words written in above his name, with a caret : can.co di s. vito di candia canon of st vitus of candia . candia is crete. read it against the arithmetic. ninety in 1716 means born about 1626 , in venetian crete. candia fell to the ottomans in september 1669 after the longest siege in european history; he would have been forty-three. a canon of a cretan church, holding after 1669 a title to a chapter that no longer existed, ends his life in a dalmatian cathedral and is buried with the canons of split. (a note on the reading: the register writes s. vito . the great church of candia was san tito st titus and a split clerk setting down an exiled cretan canonry could easily wr

t: And what that does to the Seget question
s: And then the Omiš and Split records were read too all four
q: and what that does to the seget question this archive carries a page arguing with petar puhmajer, who writes that the de franceschi bought seget from the venier in 1720 , having fled from crete after the cretan war of 1669 , and that the gologorica and seget families are two branches of one. this site contests the second half of that and has always treated the first half the cretan flight as the family's own tradition , recorded but not proved. it is no longer only tradition. here is a de franceschi with a cretan canonry , born about 1626 , dying in dalmatia in 1716 four years before the seget purchase and buried among the canons of split. it does not prove the seget family's descent, and this page does not say it does. it proves something narrower and harder: that men of this surname held office in venetian crete and ended up in dalmatia after the fall of candia. the tradition now has a document standing next to it, and the place to test the rest is the chapter records of split and the archivio del duca di candia in venice where the family's nobility was already proved in 1488.

t: morì ser Piero di Franceschi da Pola
s: And Rovinj is older still 27 May 1619
q: morì ser piero di franceschi da pola adì 27 mago 1619 morì ser piero di fran- ceschi da pola. fu por- tato il suo cad[avere] … off[erta] l 24 three things in three lines. he is ser . not dominus , not plain the venetian courtesy for a man of standing below the patriciate: a merchant, a notary, a citizen. he is da pola . he is not a rovinj man. rovinj's book has him because he died there or was brought there. fu portato il suo cadavere his body was carried . somebody paid to move him. and the offering is 24 lire , where the entries above and below it on the same page run at 2, 6, 12 and 30. this is a book that records what each burial was worth to the church, and his was near the top of the page. seven years before the fiume baptisms, a hundred and forty-two years before the surname is first written at gologorica, and eighty-one years before the family this site follows reaches istria at all.

t: And the second-oldest is a man of Vodnjan
s: And Rovinj is older still 27 May 1619
q: and the second-oldest is a man of vodnjan [27 xbre 1728] e sero. ob[ito] di matt.o de franceschi da dignano l 6 a hundred and nine years later, on the same film, the same book does it again and again the man is a stranger . piero is of pola ; mattio is of dignano , which is vodnjan , twenty kilometres down the coast. this archive's inventory of regions lists vodnjan among the unplaced a town where the surname occurs and nothing joins it to anything. it now has a named man and a date. so does pola, seventy years before the run of pula baptisms this project already reads from 1659. the two oldest de franceschi on the rovinj film are not rovinj people at all. that is worth saying plainly, because a record found in a town's register is normally taken to mean a family of that town, and here it means the opposite: a register of burial offerings catches whoever dies inside the parish , including the traveller and the man carried in from somewhere else.

t: What else the Rovinj film holds
s: And Rovinj is older still 27 May 1619
q: what else the rovinj film holds sixteen records in all, and the shape of them is a household at rovinj across three generations that this archive has never written up: giacomo → vittorio de franceschi , who marries domenica moscarda , daughter of nicolò vittorio and franca → piero anto , baptised 1736 mattio de franceschi and elisabetta → martino , baptised 1722 franco de franceschi and menegha pietro defranceschi and elisabetta dalino , daughter of pietro about 1793 sinforosa de franceschi , daughter of giovanni, and maria , who marries gio batta volsi about 1801 bona defranceschi , daughter of dominicus defranceschi and oliva dorligurro , marrying antonius medelin 1843 burials: petrus, son of michael , born 1790, died 12 june 1864; petrus, son of joseph , born 1765, died 19 january 1829; and julius, son of carlo , born 1853, dead 13 february 1854 at a few months old and one that is ours. on the same film: carlo de franceschi, son of giuseppe da gologorizza and lambertina pesle , marrying maria michelcich, daughter of luca and maria. that is the historian of istria his parents named exactly as the gologorica household books name them with his marriage indexed on a rovinj film. the image has now been opened see below. it is the next thing to read on this reel.

t: 1 March 1852 Carlo De Franceschi is married at his own bedside
s: And Rovinj is older still 27 May 1619
q: 1 march 1852 carlo de franceschi is married at his own bedside 31 addì 1 marzo 1852 rovigno il signor carlo de franceschi q.m giuseppe e della sig.ra lambertina pesle di mattia, da gologorizza di pisino, assessore presso quest'i. r. corte di giustizia , celibe, d'anni 40 , contrasse matrimonio per verba de praesenti colla sig.ra maria michelcich di luca e di maria, celibe, d'anni 26 ; dispensati dalle trine pubblicazioni dall'imp. reg. capitanato distrettuale, urgente necessitate, colla nota del primo marzo c. № 898 ; confessati e communicati, interrogati furono del loro mutuo libero consenso … domenico quarantotto, coop. … al letto dello sposo, per essere gravemente ammalato , nella casa al № … alla presenza delli signori zaccaria maver, procuratore di stato sostituto , e d.r barzan, medico , testimonj. this is the most-cited de franceschi in istria the historian, the deputy, the man whose l'istria this archive spends a whole page arguing with and his own wedding has never been read here until tonight . it is not the wedding anyone would have imagined. he was married lying down. the priest came to the house and performed it al letto dello sposo, per essere gravemente ammalato at the bridegroom's bed, because he was gravely ill. the three readings of the banns were dispensed by the imperial-royal district captaincy that same day , on urgent necessity, by a note numbered 898 : t

t: And then, two years later, a small coffin
s: And Rovinj is older still 27 May 1619
q: and then, two years later, a small coffin on the same rovinj film, logged by this archive before the marriage was ever read: a burial of julius, son of carlo , born 1853, dead 13 february 1854 at a few months old. set beside the entry above, that is very likely the first child of this marriage conceived within a year of a wedding held at a sickbed, and buried before his first birthday. (doc for both records; that they are one family is inf, and rests on the name, the place and the dates)

t: How the wrong answer was reached, and why it failed
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: how the wrong answer was reached, and why it failed the check looked sound. the eighteen-town sweep counted by place-name ; the later sweep resolved records to the parish reel they sit on and produced ninety-three parishes with no vodnjan among them. following the image arks gave dgs 005497893 , and asking the catalogue who made that film returned rimokatolička crkva. župa vižinada . case apparently closed. the catalogue answers by film, and a film can carry more than one parish. reel 005497893 holds two items: vižinada umrli 1754 1831 , the deaths vodnjan rođeni 1815 1866 , the baptisms a search by film number returns the first creator on the reel. the method was right and the question put to it was wrong , and this archive published the result inside twenty minutes without opening a single image. the regions row has been restored.

s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: the registers, found familysearch catalogue item koha:963267 : metrical books (births, marriages, deaths) for the roman catholic congregation at dignano, küstenland, austria; later vodnjan, croatia . text in italian. dgs 005497893 baptisms 1815 1866 dgs 005497894 baptisms 1867 1878 marriages 1815 1884 deaths 1815 1833 dgs 005497895 deaths 1834 1893 seventy-eight years of baptisms, seventy of marriages, seventy-eight of deaths , and until today this project did not know they existed.

t: LIBER BAPTIZATORUM IN ECCLESIA S. BLASII DIGNANI
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: liber baptizatorum in ecclesia s. blasii dignani 149 4 decembre [1816] № domus 376 d. stefano de franceschi (de parocho licentia) domenica maria de franceschi , nata li 1.mo decembre catholica femina legitima pater: pietro de franceschi di giuseppe, agricoltore mater: maria malusà q.m matteo di antonio patrini: pietro ved… di raffael × maria lu…anza di franc… conditio: civile the book is headed for the church of st blaise of dignano the great basilica of vodnjan and the first de franceschi entry gives more in one ruled line than most parishes give in a paragraph. a house number: 376. a grandfather: pietro is di giuseppe . a mother with three generations of her own: maria malusà, daughter of the late matteo, son of antonio. and a status: civile . and look who is holding the child. the baptising column reads d. stefano de franceschi, de parocho licentia don stefano de franceschi, by licence of the parish priest. a priest of this surname was serving at vodnjan in 1816 , and he is not baptising only his own kin: on the facing page, on 1 january 1817, he baptises a mescheni child whose mother is michiela de franceschi di giovanni . a priest of the name, and at least five lay households of it, in one small istrian town. this archive has never had that anywhere except gologorica.

s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: the five households, now anchored indexed, and now known to be vodnjan rather than nowhere: pietro × maria malusà domenica maria 1816, domenica michiela giovanna 1818, teresa domenica 1820, stefano matteo 1822, cristoforo 1824 pietro × maddalena francin maria martina 1822, pasqua 1824, giovanni 1827, lucia 1828 domenico × zacchera cerlon pietro 1817, pietro 1819, franco 1821, domenica 1822, pasqua 1825, pietro 1828, domenica 1830, maria 1833; then × pasqua gorlato maria 1839; then × maria oliva dorliguzzo pietro 1837, bonetta 1841, arveneria 1844 stefano × bonetta vellico domenico giovanni anto 1819, martina 1824, maria 1829 gio maria × lucia bonassin veniera 1822, lucia 1826, giovanni 1829, stefano 1831 domenico baptises three sons called pietro in eleven years and buries two wives. the marriage register, 1815 1884, is on film 005497894 and would name every one of these wives' fathers. it has not been opened.

t: And the death on that reel is somebody else's
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: and the death on that reel is somebody else's 7 [augusti 1819] № domus 32 mathaeus de franceschi fil[ius] antonii the one death record among these is not vodnjan's at all. its page is headed liber defunctorum castellier kaštelir , a chapelry under vižinada , in the deaths section at the front of the same reel. so the film really does carry de franceschi in two parishes forty kilometres apart , and that is exactly why the wrong answer looked right. mathaeus de franceschi, son of anton, of house 32 at kaštelir, born about 1750, died 7 august 1819 and he belongs on the vižinada side of the reel, not the vodnjan one.

t: Vodnjan and Rovinj, joined at both ends of a century
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: vodnjan and rovinj, joined at both ends of a century two records now tie the two towns together. 1728 in the rovinj book of burial offerings: ob.to di matt.o de franceschi da dignano l 6 . a man of vodnjan, dead in rovinj. 1840s on the rovinj film: bona defranceschi, daughter of dominicus defranceschi and oliva dorligurro , marrying antonius medelin . that is the third household above domenico's third marriage sending a daughter to rovinj. both of these places sat in this archive's inventory as unplaced . they are not unconnected; they are connected to each other, a hundred and twenty years apart, and nobody had put the two rows side by side.

t: LIBER COPULATORUM IN ECCLESIA S. BLASII ADIGNANI
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: liber copulatorum in ecclesia s. blasii adignani the marriage book is on dgs 005497894 , and familysearch has never indexed it . two hundred and eighty-six marriage-query arks were resolved against that film and not one of them landed on it. every marriage in this section has therefore been read off the page by eye, opening after opening. the volume's cover is at image 170 ; the first entry, annus 1815 , at image 172 ; the next volume begins at image 266 . roughly ninety-four openings, 1815 to 1884 . the folio numbers are stamped in the corner and run odd on the right 178 recto is folio 11, 179 recto folio 13 so the reading order can be checked against the book itself rather than against the film. what follows is images 172 182 : doc on every line, because every line was photographed and read.

t: 30 March 1818 the marriage this archive came for
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: 30 march 1818 the marriage this archive came for 15 30 marzo [1818] № domus 312 sponsus pietro de franceschi q.m gio. maria , vedovo della q.m veniera franzin q.m domenico cattolico d'anni 42 vedovo sponsa lorenza tesser q.m ambrogio , vedova del q.m andrea manzin fu altro andrea cattolica d'anni 40 vedova testes + gio. batta d'ambra, fabbro + antonio bellicaglia di giovanni, muratore a whole generation arrives in six lines. pietro is forty-two , so born about 1776 and his father gio. maria de franceschi is already dead , which carries the family in vodnjan back into the middle of the eighteenth century, well behind the register's own first page. he is a widower : there was a first wife, veniera franzin , daughter of a domenico franzin, and she died before march 1818. he marries another widow, lorenza tesser , whose first husband was andrea manzin. this is not the pietro of the baptism above. that one is pietro de franceschi di giuseppe di , father living. this one is q.m gio. maria father dead. two men of the same name in one small town at the same moment , and the register keeps them apart by naming the father every single time. (doc) one caution, marked plainly: the baptism register of 1816 records gio maria de franceschi as a living household head. if pietro's father gio. maria was dead by 1818, then the gio maria fathering children in the 1820s is a second man of the name

t: Two brothers, and both of them sign with a cross
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: two brothers, and both of them sign with a cross twice in 1818 a de franceschi stands as witness, and both times the clerk writes a cross before the name the mark of a man who cannot write his own. 30 march 1818 , entry 14, house 391, at the wedding of lorenzo bilucaglia and domenica giacometti: + cristoforo de franceschi di giuseppe tessitore a weaver . 14 september 1818 , entry 25, house 457, at the wedding of domenico coffetti and maria zoghil da gimino: + pietro de franceschi di giuseppe agricoltore the father of the child baptised in december 1816. cristoforo and pietro, both di giuseppe . same father, alive, named the same way in the same hand within six months: they are brothers . (inf, and a strong one) and a tension worth stating rather than smoothing over. the baptism of december 1816 records the household's conditio as civile . the marriage register calls pietro agricoltore and shows him unable to sign . those are the two columns of two different books and they may simply be asking different questions but this archive is not going to quietly publish the flattering one. (doc for both readings; the reconciliation is unresolved)

t: Don Stefano De Franceschi, placed and then given a father
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: don stefano de franceschi, placed and then given a father 15 7 giugno [1819] № domus 718 sponsus antonio, figlio di domenico belci q.m andrea e domenica giachin q.m domenico sponsa natalia, figlia del q.m stefano codalovich q.m ant.o e di vita tromba q.m cristoforo d'anni 20 testes don stefano de franceschi sacerdote martino fioranti fu giò. artista joannes tromba sac. theol. doct. parochus capitulique praepositus in the baptism of 4 december 1816 he appears as d. stefano de franceschi (de parocho licentia) he baptised the child by the parish priest's leave , which told us he was a priest but not which one, or whose. here he is again, thirty months later, signing as a witness in his own right and styled simply sacerdote . and the foot of the page names the man who gave him that leave: giovanni tromba, doctor of sacred theology, parish priest and provost of the chapter . so don stefano was not the parish priest of vodnjan. he was a priest of the town , one of the chapter's clergy, free to be asked for at a family baptism and to stand up at a neighbour's wedding. he is also, so far, the only literate de franceschi in vodnjan the only one whose name is written without a cross in front of it. (doc) and then, on 17 august 1820 , the clerk writes him out in full: d.n stefano de franceschi di giuseppe sacerdote di giuseppe. the same patronymic, in the same hand, in the same book, as +

t: Domenica De Franceschi, dead before the book begins
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: domenica de franceschi, dead before the book begins 21 19 novembre [1817] № domus 145 sponsus giuseppe, figlio di fran.co manzin q.m giuseppe e di cattarina manzin q.m andrea d'anni 25 sponsa giovanna, figlia di tommaso mivinurro q.m gio. e della fu dom.ca de franceschi d'anni 40 the bride is forty in 1817, so born about 1777 , and her mother domenica de franceschi was already dead when the entry was written. run it backwards. a woman whose daughter was born in 1777 was herself born somewhere around 1750 . she was baptised, married and buried in a vodnjan whose registers, on this film, do not start until 1815 . she is the reach of this book backwards past its own first page: proof of de franceschi in vodnjan by the middle of the eighteenth century , from a record written sixty years later. (doc for the entry; the arithmetic is inf) she also sits within a lifetime of ob.to di matt.o de franceschi da dignano , buried at rovinj on 27 december 1728 until today the only evidence this archive had that the name was in the town at all.

q: 27 july 1833 the brothers get a mother, and she is a tromba 34 27 luglio 1833 № domus 324 sponsa maria francesca , figlia del fu giuseppe de franceschi q.m pietro e di lucia tromba q.m cristoforo , giugali cattolica d'anni 28 celibe testes fran.co davanzo fu gio., trafficante sig.r andrea tromba fu matteo, possidente civile the household this archive has been circling since march 1818 don stefano the priest, pietro the ploughman, cristoforo the weaver, all di giuseppe finally opens. del fu giuseppe de franceschi q.m pietro e di lucia tromba q.m cristoforo . that is a father for giuseppe (a pietro), a wife for giuseppe (lucia tromba), and a fourth child : maria francesca, twenty-eight, so born about 1805 . and giuseppe is del fu dead which sits exactly inside the bracket the weaver's own patronymic gave: after november 1828, before february 1833. and the mother is a tromba. the parish priest who signs the foot of every page of this book is giovanni tromba, doctor of sacred theology, parroco and provost of the chapter . one of the two witnesses here is andrea tromba, possidente civile . that reframes the whole household. a family of a ploughman and a weaver who cannot write their own names produced a priest of the chapter and their mother came from the family that held the parish. it also explains the formula that has run through this reading from the start: don stefano acting de

s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: the death register, opened 54 11 marzo 1829 № domus 325 maria, figlia di stefano de franceschi e di bonetta vellico q.m antonio, giugali liber defunctorum in ecclesia s. blasii adignani the third book on the film. deaths 1815 1833 run from about image 471 to 575 , in a latin-headed ruling tempus mortis nrus domus nomen defuncti religio sexus aetas morbus seu causa mortis about thirteen entries a page, twenty-six an opening, and roughly six images to the year. it is not indexed either. a query for de franceschi deaths across 1826 1836 in the whole of croatia returns eight dated records , none of them from this parish. the first entry read out of it belongs to stefano de franceschi and bonetta vellico one of the eight households this archive reconstructed from the baptism index months ago. their daughter maria died on 11 march 1829 at house 325 . the household had children recorded 1819 1829; now it has a burial too, and a house number. what this book is being read for: giuseppe de franceschi , whose death his sons' patronymics bracket to between november 1828 and february 1833 , and who should therefore be somewhere in images 546 575. t: The death book gives two households their dead
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: the death book gives two households their dead 54 11 marzo 1829 № domus 325 maria, figlia di stefano de franceschi e di bonetta vellico q.m antonio , giugali 96 23 luglio 1829 № domus 48 pietro, figlio di dom.co de franceschi q.m pietro e di zacchera cerlon di franc.o , giugali two of the eight households reconstructed from the baptism index now have a burial and a house number and the second has something better. dom.co de franceschi q.m pietro . the baptism index gave this household as a bare pair of names, domenico × zacchera cerlon , with children 1817 1833. the death of their son pietro on 23 july 1829 at house 48 names domenico's own dead father: a pietro . that is a fifth pietro in this parish, or one of the four already known and the register does not say which. what it does say is that the household has a generation above it, which the baptism book never showed. t: 14 February 1830 Giuseppe, found, and the bracket closes exactly
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: 14 february 1830 giuseppe, found, and the bracket closes exactly 27 14 febrajo 1830 № domus 324 giuseppe de franceschi q.m pietro era ammogliato con lucia tromba fu cristoforo cattolico maschio d'anni 72 morbus seu causa mortis: vizio organico di petto sacramenti: senza assistenza spirituale per morte improvvisa and five months later 77 13 luglio 1830 № domus 501 lucia de franceschi q.m pietro era moglie di alviso birattan q.m sabà cattolica femmina d'anni 70 ascite universale the father of the priest, the ploughman and the weaver. this archive had never seen a date for him it had a bracket , derived from nothing but how his sons were written: di giuseppe in november 1828, fu giuseppe in february 1833. the register gives 14 february 1830 . inside the bracket, and the bracket was right. and it gives four things the marriages never could. he was seventy-two , so born about 1758 . he died at house 324 the house his daughter maria francesca would marry out of three years later. the cause was an organic defect of the chest . and the sacraments column, which is usually a formula, says he died suddenly, with no priest : senza assistenza spirituale per morte improvvisa . his son was a priest of that parish, licensed by the parroco to baptise and to marry. don stefano did not get to his own father. q: 11 september 1830 house 325 gets its family 94 11 settembre 1830 № domus 325 bonetta vellico q.m antonio, moglie di stefano de franceschi di domenico q.m pietro cattolica femmina d'anni 57 tisi polmonare eighteen months after her daughter maria died in the same house, bonetta vellico dies at house 325 of pulmonary consumption, aged fifty-seven so born about 1773 . and the clerk writes her husband out three generations deep: stefano de franceschi di domenico q.m pietro . note the two different words. di domenico his father was alive in september 1830. q.m pietro his grandfather was not. so a third vodnjan line stands: pietro → domenico → stefano , with domenico still living. and house 325 is now theirs. this archive flagged that number two days ago because it also appears against domenico de franceschi, forty-six, son of a pietro and martina civico , remarrying in july 1832 . the house is stefano and bonetta's; the domenico who married out of it two years later shares a grandfather's name with stefano's own father. the connection is now likely rather than merely possible and the exact link is still open. on the stated ages the 1832 domenico (born about 1786) is too young to be stefano's father, so the readings on the table are: two brothers of one name, an uncle, or an age the register got wrong. this archive is not going to pick one. t: What the death book says about the town, while you are looking for one man
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: what the death book says about the town, while you are looking for one man scanning 1817 and 1818 for veniera francin she is not there, so she died earlier the book says something else instead. 1817 ran to 222 deaths. page after page of febbre gastrico-nervosa maligna , often with (tifo) written beside it: typhus , through a walled town, in the year of the great post-napoleonic famine across the whole of central europe. and on 31 december 1817 , three entries in a row giovanni bonassin , 28; michiel vertorich , 22; antonio giurich , 24 each with the same cause: morte violenta di supplizio . violent death by execution. three young men of the parish, hanged or shot on the last day of the year. none of them is ours. it is recorded because a family archive that only lifts out its own name is reading a town's register and seeing nothing. t: An eleven-year-old, and a marriage pushed back four years
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: an eleven-year-old, and a marriage pushed back four years 15 december 1830, house 456. pietro figlio di pietro de franceschi q.m pietro e di maddalena francin di giovanni giugali , dead at eleven of scarlatina , senza assistenza spirituale per la malattia repentina . the archive already had this couple, from four baptisms running 1822 to 1828 . this boy was born about 1819 , which moves their marriage back to 1818 at the latest and makes him the eldest of five, not a child they never had. the two little words do the rest. q.m pietro the father's father was already dead. di giovanni the mother's father was still alive. and the house is 456 , which is neither giuseppe's 324 nor stefano's 325 . three houses, three de franceschi families, one small walled town.

s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: scarlet fever, december 1830 he did not die alone. entries 150, 151, 152, 153 and 155 all give the cause as scarlatina , and the ages beside them are seven, eleven, six, six and a child. two of them, on either side of him, are the children of bortoluzzi and bendonicchio the same illness moving down the same street . the column is headed aetas and the clerk writes d'an. 11 . it is the only place in these registers where this archive can watch an epidemic take a named child of the family, hour by hour, with the sacrament column recording that nobody got there in time.

t: A sixth woman, found because her daughter died
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: a sixth woman, found because her daughter died 6 january 1831, house 24. domenica figlia di andrea palin q.m pio. e della fu michiela de franceschi fu pietro giugali. two deaths in one line, and neither is the subject of the entry. della fu buries the mother; fu pietro buries her father. michiela de franceschi was dead before january 1831 , and this archive would never have learned her name if her daughter had lived. that is now the sixth vodnjan woman recovered this way the surname keeps its sons and loses its daughters, and the only reliable way back to them is a child's death entry that has to name the mother to say whose child it was.

t: Two entries that were not ours, and why they looked as if they were
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: two entries that were not ours, and why they looked as if they were at the zoom that lets you scan a page in four passes, q.m francesco and di francesco are indistinguishable from de franceschi . two entries on image 560 were flagged and both had to be given up on a closer look: entry 157 , nicolò sussani q.m francesco , and entry 16 , antonia palin di francesco legittimi giugali . both are patronymics son of the late francesco , daughter of francesco . the surname the eye wants is not there. in a parish this full of francescos, every candidate has to be re-read at full magnification before it is written down , and two out of four on a single page did not survive that.

t: A slip of paper, and somebody else's unfinished search
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: a slip of paper, and somebody else's unfinished search image 561 photographs the same opening again, this time with a loose slip lying across the left-hand page so december 1830 is hidden and the slip is filmed instead. on one side: cercare ne' libri de' morti maria celin fu moglie del fu marco silla, morto da anni 25, 26 c.a . search the books of the dead. somebody, at some point, wanted to know when marco silla died and left themselves a note about it in the book they meant to search. on the other, upside down: a draft death entry 165 dom.ca gasparro fu dom.co e cat.a baldarin № 505, morta li 23 ottobre 1843, da male di petto and two names, giorgio cossich e fran.co maravo . neither side is this family. it is here because it is parish office scrap from 1843 left in an 1831 opening and photographed because nobody moved it , and because the archive is in no position to be superior about an unfinished search.

t: What it is and is not
s: And there is a palace in Zadar with the name on it
q: what it is and is not a double-barrelled house name in zadar means a marriage, not a merger: a franceschi daughter or son married into the grisogono, and the palace carried both names afterwards. the grisogono are one of the oldest patrician families of the city heyer von rosenfeld starts their genealogy at a grisogono de grisogoni in 1290. this archive does not know which franceschi. it knows that in zadar the name was attached to two buildings on the main street, and that is more than it knew this morning.

s: And there is a palace in Zadar with the name on it
q: the reference to get antoljak's footnote 155 reads: o toj porodici v. članak famiglia franceschi , il rammentatore zaratino, lunario per l'anno 1859, zara, 30. on this family see the article famiglia franceschi , in the zadar almanac for the year 1859, p. 30. an article devoted to the franceschi family of zadar, printed in 1859, in a serial this project has never touched. it is one page. it is the single most findable unread thing this archive now knows about, and it sits in the znanstvena knjižnica zadar or the državni arhiv u zadru.

s: And there is a palace in Zadar with the name on it
q: and a second one footnote 156 sends you to giuseppe sabalich, guida archeologica di zara , at pages 375 377, 470 471 and 497 498 the archaeological guide's own account of those buildings. sabalich is on the internet archive. footnote 157 is heyer von rosenfeld's wappenbuch des königreichs dalmatien , nürnberg 1873, which is the same armorial that admitted this family's zadar branch to the dalmatian nobility.

t: Brooklyn, 1 April 1930 three of the Eleven under one roof
q: brooklyn, 1 april 1930 three of the eleven under one roof united states census of 1930, brooklyn, kings county, new york nara t626, roll 1495. read the four names against the reunion chart. albina is the sixth of the eleven, born at gračišće on 14 april 1900. anthony is the eldest, born 18 february 1887 and the census gives his year of immigration as 1922 , which is the year of the passenger list this archive found under his name. and grochina is what a brooklyn enumerator made of gioacchino , the tenth child, born 12 august 1907, whom the family called bruno . a sister, her husband, and two of her brothers, in one flat, on one census night. one of them had crossed the atlantic eight years earlier; one would marry a german girl from hanover sixteen months later. nothing in this archive had put any two of them in the same room.

t: Gallignana returns ten records in the whole of Findmypast and three are ours
q: gallignana returns ten records in the whole of findmypast and three are ours the obvious search, and nobody had run it. type the village's italian name into the keyword box of a database of billions of records and ten results come back . three carry this family's name. joseph defranceschi petition for naturalization, brooklyn, 1915. birth date 12 mar 1892 birth country austria birth place as transcribed: gallignana, austria . petition 13838, declaration 22660, certificate 1104860 . albina schinkepan petition for naturalization, brooklyn, 1928. birth date 14 apr 1900 birth place as transcribed: gallignana, austria husband frank schinkepan, born 24 feb 1896 . petition 100185. the name of this village is written into the federal records of the united states, twice, by two of the eleven children of antonio and maria. not austria , not italy , not trieste gallignana . it is the plainest documentary tie between the hill town this archive is built on and the country half the family went to. the other seven are the village's other emigrants, and they are worth naming because a village of that size sends its people out together: poldrugovac thomas (b.1899, petitions of 1921 and 1941) and poldrugovaz santo (b.1900, 1946); millassich leopoldo (b.1883) and emilia (b.1889), arriving 1912; lanza anthony (b.1892); silich victor. six surnames out of one parish, in the new york courts.

t: 11 … 1922 the Conte Rosso, Genoa to New York
q: 11 … 1922 the conte rosso, genoa to new york and then the two records that sit beside each other in the index, one number apart, on one page of one ship's manifest. antonio de franceschi passenger male age 35y birth year 1887 nationality italy, slovenian residence g. pedena, venezia, italy year 1922 departure port genoa arrival new york ship name conte rosso. and in the relations field: departure port relation (wife): marta defranceschi . albina de franceschi passenger female age 22y birth year 1900 nationality italy, italian residence g. gallignana, venezia year 1922 departure port genoa arrival new york ship name conte rosso. brother and sister, thirty-five and twenty-two, on the same crossing. the eldest of the eleven and the sixth, going down to genoa from opposite ends of the same few miles of istria he from pedena, which is pićan , the cathedral town over the hill; she from gallignana . the conte rosso was a lloyd sabaudo liner two years old that year. three details this archive did not have and would not have guessed. antonio was living at pićan, not gračišće. he left a wife behind him marta defranceschi, named at the departure port, which is why the census of 1930 finds him married but lodging with his sister eight years later. and an american clerk wrote his nationality as italy, slovenian and hers as italy, italian the same household, the same village, sorted into two

frank, out of pisino albina's husband takes a different spelling in every record chinikopan on the 1925 marriage licence, chinkojan in the 1930 census, schinkepan on her 1928 petition. search the keyword pisino and he appears under a fourth: schinkopan, frank, born 1896 united states naturalization petitions, new york, 1920 and 1926. born 24 february 1896 , out of pisino pazin , the county town. he declared his intention in 1920, petitioned in 1926, married albina of gallignana in between, and by 1930 was keeping a brooklyn household with two of her brothers in it. four spellings of one man, and the archive can now say where he came from.

t: 23 April 1925 Albina's marriage, and her mother's name
q: 23 april 1925 albina's marriage, and her mother's name albine defranceschi , spinster, aged 25, born 1900 married frank chinikopan , aged 28, born 1897, at kings county, new york, on 23 april 1925 . father's first name(s): anton. mother's first name(s): maria. mother's last name: volhart. that is the couple at the head of the 2012 chart antonio defranceschi 1856 1924 + maria valhart 1867 1945 and it is the surname the gračišće status animarum of 1925 spells volhardt . a new york clerk, working from what the bride told him, wrote her mother's maiden name into the civil record of the state of new york. the reunion album's albina chinkopan is frank chinikopan , and this archive now has the day.

t: 30 July 1931 Bruno's marriage, and the name the gravestone cut off
q: 30 july 1931 bruno's marriage, and the name the gravestone cut off bruno de franceschi , single, aged 24, birth place: istria, italy married gerda seedorf , aged 18, birth place: hanover, germany , at manhattan on 30 july 1931 . his father anton ; his mother mary walhal . her father john seedorf; her mother anna huntsen. the stone at nine partners cemetery, millbrook, gave this archive a wife it could read only as gerda se… . she was gerda seedorf of hanover , eighteen years old, marrying a boy from istria in manhattan two years into the depression.

t: 1939 a declaration of intention at Brooklyn, and whose it really is
q: 1939 a declaration of intention at brooklyn, and whose it really is united states naturalization petitions, brooklyn, kings, new york, 1939. declaration of intention no. 284221 ; certificate 2-665402 . first name bruno last name de franceschi birth date 12 aug 1907 spouse gerda de franceschi, born 15 jan 1913 relation 2: child, born 2 december 1932 . 12 august 1907 is the reunion album's date for gioacchino, to the day. but see the correction below : the image behind this index entry is gerda's own declaration, not bruno's, and everything here was extracted from her form. there is a son, born 2 december 1932, who is not named here because he may be living.

t: Uncle Joe, from a draft card to a war grave
q: uncle joe, from a draft card to a war grave the second son, giuseppe uncle joe born 3 march 1892 on the chart. four records, in order: 1917 18 world war i draft registration cards, new york city board no. 27. joseph defranceschi birth date 12 mar 1892 place of birth as transcribed frieste birth country austria citizenship united states . the american records this archive already had gave 12 march, not the chart's 3 march; the draft card is where that comes from. frieste is trieste what an istrian says to a new york clerk who has never heard of gallignana. 20 may 1926 manhattan. he marries maria duda , born 1903 in new jersey. father anton ; mother maria valbart . the mother's name again, from a third child, in a third record. 1 april 1940 united states census, brooklyn. head of household, aged 48, born austria, at the same address as in 1935. with him his wife mary , 36, born new jersey maria duda and two children, a daughter born 1927 and a son born 1929 , both born in new jersey. this archive had not known he had children. 26 april 1940 u.s. veteran's gravesites. joseph de franceschi died 26 apr 1940 rank sergeant us army world war i long island national cemetery , farmingdale, new york section f, site 2918 . twenty-five days after the census taker wrote him down. the grave record carries no birth year, so the identification rests on the name, the borough, and a first world w

basilio, to the day the youngest of the eleven, basilio, born 29 september 1909 . the social security death index and the obituary index agree: basilio defranceschi 29 september 1909 15 june 1994 new york, new york , social security number issued in new york. born at gračišće while it was austria; died in new york city, aged eighty-four, in the summer of 1994. this archive had no death date for him at all.

t: The mother's name, in three hands
q: the mother's name, in three hands it is worth setting these side by side, because they were written by three different clerks, in three different years, from what three different children of the same woman told them: albina, 1925 anton maria volhart joseph, 1926 anton maria valbart bruno, 1931 anton mary walhal and the parish book of souls at gračišće, house 24: maria volhardt , 6 april 1867 3 october 1945. four spellings, one woman. this is what a german surname does in the mouths of istrian children and the ears of new york registrars, and it is the strongest identification in this whole sweep: the three of the eleven who married in new york all named the same mother.
